title: From a picture
prompt: Using grafta, turn poster.png into a Figma file. Make it editable.

beats.title: Starts the file
beats.says: A new Figma file, the size of the picture.

beats.title: Draws the layout
beats.says: Frames and shapes where the picture has them.

beats.title: Sets the text
beats.says: Real text layers, in the picture's type and colours.

beats.title: Checks it against the picture
beats.says: Renders the file to compare.

beats.title: Saves a new file
beats.says: Read back and compared equal.

outcome.summary: The poster as layers: text, shapes and frames you can edit in Figma.

title: Theme it
prompt: Open order.fig with grafta. Add a High contrast mode to its Theme, render the Order screen in Light, Dark and High contrast, and save the result.

beats.title: Reads the file
beats.says: Finds the Order screen and the Theme's Light and Dark modes.

beats.title: Adds a mode
beats.says: A High contrast mode on the Theme collection.

beats.title: Fills in its colours
beats.says: A value per colour, in the new mode.

beats.title: Renders each mode
beats.says: The screen in Light, Dark and High contrast.

beats.title: Saves a new file
beats.says: Read back and compared equal.

outcome.summary: A third theme mode, its colours filled in, the screen rendered in all three.

title: Audit it
prompt: Open order.fig with grafta and audit its design system: its tokens, components and styles, and whether its text is bound to them.

beats.title: Opens the file
beats.says: Its pages and what it holds.

beats.title: Lists its system
beats.says: Its variables, components and styles.

beats.title: Checks its text
beats.says: Whether each text is bound to a variable.

beats.title: Looks at the screen
beats.says: Renders it to check what it read.

outcome.summary: A report of the file's tokens, components and styles, and the text bound to them.

title: Fix contrast
prompt: Open checkout.fig with grafta, check the Order screen's text against WCAG AA, fix what fails with the file's own colours, and show me before and after.

beats.title: Finds the screen
beats.says: Opens checkout.fig and finds the Order frame.

beats.title: Checks every text
beats.says: Against WCAG AA, on what is drawn behind it.

beats.title: Fixes it
beats.says: With one of the file's own colours.

beats.title: Checks again
beats.says: Every text passes.

beats.title: Saves a new file
beats.says: Read back and compared equal.

outcome.summary: The text that failed WCAG AA fixed with the file's own colour, checked again.

title: Fill from data
prompt: Open order.fig with grafta. Make the order card a component, and place it once per order, for orders 4821, 4907 and 5013, in a new list.

beats.title: Finds the card
beats.says: Opens order.fig and finds the Card frame.

beats.title: Makes it a component
beats.says: The card becomes reusable.

beats.title: Places one per order
beats.says: A list, each card with its own order number.

beats.title: Saves a new file
beats.says: Read back and compared equal.

outcome.summary: The card made a component, placed once per order in a new list.

title: Bring in a web page
prompt: Import pricing.json, a browser's snapshot of our pricing cards, into a new page of order.fig with grafta, as layers the design team can edit.

beats.title: Opens the file
beats.says: order.fig, and a new page for the import.

beats.title: Imports the web page
beats.says: Frames, texts and auto-layout the team can edit.

beats.title: Saves a new file
beats.says: Read back and compared equal.

outcome.summary: The pricing page as editable frames, text and auto-layout.
